content: Hessafe guye shaara may7ida hara mino kiitanchchay saloppe duge wodhdhizayssa beyadis; zuullay iza hu7e yuuyi aadhdhides; iza ayfesoy arshe misatees; iza tohotikka tama tuus misateettes.
Xaaththafe birshettida issi guuththa maxaafa dizaaro ba kushen oykki uttides; izi ba ushachcha tohozan abbaa hadirsa tohozan qasse biitta yedhdhi eqqides.
Gaammo xaago mala gita qaalara xaaggides; izi xaaggida mala laappun dadati ba giirissaa sissida.
Laappun dadati ba giirissaa sissida mala ta xaafana gaada qoppadis shin, «Ha laappun dadati yootoyssa qum7a woththa attiin xaafoppa!» giza qaala saloppe siyadis.
Hessafe kaallidi abbaa bollanne biittaa bolla eqqi dishin ta be7ida kiitanchchazi ba ushachcha kushe pude salo denththidi,
mernaappe mernaas dizayssan, salonne salon dizayta qasseka biittanne biitta garsan dizayta, abbanne abba giddon dizayta medhdhida Xoossaa sunth xeygi caaqqidi, «Hayssafe guye izi gam7enna!
Gido attiin laappunththa kiitanchchay ba zayeza punni sissiza gallassatan izi ba oosanchchatassinne nabetas erisida mala Xoossa xuuray polettana» gides.
Hessafe guye tani saloppe siyida qaalay, «Abbaa bollanne biittaa bolla eqqida kiitanchchaza kushen doyetti diza xaaththa maxaafaza baada ekka!» giidi qasseka taas yootides.
Tani qasse kiitanchchazaakko baada, «Hinno qeeri xaaththan diza maxaafayo taas imma» gadis. Izikka, «Hey ekkada ma! Iza nena ne ulo giddon cammana; gido attiin ne doonan eessa mala mal7ana» gides.
Tanikka he qeeri xaaththa maxaafayo kiitanchchaza kusheppe ekkada madis; izakka ta doonan tana eessa mala mal7adus; gido attiin ta maada aggiin guyeppe ta ulo giddon tana cammadus.
Hessafe guye, «Daro dumma dumma qommo asa gishshas dumma dumma qaalan haasayza asata gishshassinne kawota gishshas qasseka tinbite ne yootana mala nees bessees» geetettidi taas yootettides.
